title: Resolution urging Albany to treat postpartum illness as sentencing factor
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, legislation recognizing postpartum mental illness as a mitigating factor in criminal sentencing. It cites research estimating postpartum psychosis affects about 4,000 women nationally each year and notes New York law currently has no such provision, unlike Illinois, which enacted a similar law in 2018.
